questions.qtext: If $\mathrm{P} @ \mathrm{Q}$ means $\text{P}$ is the brother of $\mathrm{Q}, \mathrm{P} \Delta \mathrm{Q}$ means $\text{P}$ is the mother of $\text{Q}$ and $\mathrm{P} \phi \mathrm{Q}$ means $\text{P}$ is the sister of $Q$, then which of the following would mean $\text{A}$ is the uncle of $\text{B}$?
questions.solution:
Answer: C

Source solution 1 (score: 0)
$\textbf{(c)}$ $\text{A}$ is the uncle of $\text{B}$ means $\text{A}$ is the brother of the mother of $\text{B}$. According to the given expressions. It must be $\mathrm{A} @ \mathrm{PAB}$, so the answer is $\textbf{(c)}$.
